title: Deep Cogito v2: Open-source AI that hones its reasoning skills
description:
Deep Cogito has released Cogito v2, a new family of open-source AI models that sharpen their own reasoning skills. Released under an open-source licence, the new Cogito v2 lineup includes four hybrid reasoning AI models: two mid-sized at 70B and 109B parameters, and two large-scale versions at 405B and 671B.  The largest, a 671B Mixture-of-Experts […]
